source.execution_source: Both jobs check out the same dispatched committed Git revision containing this plan. The revision is carried in preparation, reader, DAO and Rust snapshots/receipts. The reviewed source commit identifies the scaffold; input hashes pin meaningful workflow/recipe/snapshot/evaluation sources. No independent build attestation is introduced.

authorization: The user authorized DAO experiments and mutations. Commit and independently review this exact plan, merge reviewed tooling, and perform one workflow_dispatch with run_acquisition=true and this plan SHA-256. No additional license acceptance or installation is authorized by this plan.
question: Do three exact public-created deep, nullable numeric and multiple-index recipes match stock hosted DAO full semantic snapshots, complete directed traversal and declared finite Seek observations while every original file stays unchanged?

inventory.contract: Separate deterministic recipes; original consumed twelve-case write inventory/runtime remains unchanged.

inputs.plan_sha256: SHA-256 of these exact committed plan bytes

execution.producer: Ubuntu builds the locked public creation fixture and snapshot CLI. Generate each deterministic recipe through create_database_with_rows, inspect actual tree depths and exact inline tree map membership with public reader APIs, retain layout.json and MDB SHA before snapshot. Snapshot all rows and metadata, validate declared recipes/coverage and unchanged identity, retain all logs.
execution.consumer: Windows2022 downloads the exact same-run source artifact. Independently verify image/layout identities and actual tree boundaries with public reader APIs, then produce Rust snapshots. Retain the strict ready x86 DAO.DBEngine.36/dbVersion30 environment receipt and its manifest hash. Open all three exact files read-only with stock DAO and retain complete semantic snapshots and index sidecars.
execution.helpers: PowerShell loads only the named snapshot helper function ASTs from the pinned original read script; it never executes its top-level acquisition or changes consumed read files.
execution.comparison: Require complete schema, typed row multiset, full directed traversal, exact source/scenario/image/coverage/layout/provider bindings and unchanged files. Deep Long: exactly nine declared Seek keys [-13900,-13899,-13701,-13700,-13699,-1,0,13899,13900], never exhaustive Seek. Nullable Currency/Double: every120 non-null full key; exclude six null-bearing rows only from Seek, retaining them in complete traversal/snapshots. Three Long indexes: every201 primary,3 ordinary and201 composite non-null full key; duplicate Seek selects any complete matching row only after complete traversal validation.
execution.limits: Three deterministic recipes:27801 Long rows/depth3;126 nullable numeric rows/depth2;201rows/three Long indexes/depth2 each. Generation/snapshot subprocess300seconds, Ubuntu20minutes, Windows30minutes. No acquisition retry or provider installation.

decision_rule.matched: All three recipes generated; all independent tree/layout, source/provider/identity, full snapshot and traversal, and finite Seek gates pass. Only these three hosted creation cases match; support-state movement is a separate reviewed change.
decision_rule.no_outcome: Any provider prerequisite failure, incomplete job, failed generation/read/snapshot, changed image, invalid bindings, recipe mismatch or index comparison failure prevents matched. The evaluator retains report.json no_outcome for evaluation failures; earlier failures retain their preparation/provider/workflow diagnostics without inventing a comparison report. Validate those available JSON artifacts before recording one honest outcome.
decision_rule.retry: GitHub attempt must be1; do not rerun jobs or redispatch this scientific acquisition automatically. A post-first-DAO-mutation failure remains a result. Any successor requires a separate decision and plan, never editing this consumed plan.

retention.contents: Exact generated MDBs, preparation.json and stdout/stderr, environment.json, reader.json, all raw/canonical DAO and Rust snapshots, coverage receipts, index probes, per-scenario comparisons and report.json when reached. Preserve failure artifacts and hosted run/job logs. Never commit MDB/provider binaries. Also retain layout.json, independent Windows layout logs and exact9/120/405 Seek query results.
retention.outcome: One additive EXP-0214 derived from validated retained JSON. Preserve all consumed local/hosted originals, including EXP-0194 no_outcome and separate EXP-0202 secondary evidence.

coverage_limits: Only declared depths/counts, not arbitrary index depth or allocation policy
No creation/update duplicate or Required rejection probes in this hosted acquisition
No Date/Binary/Text/GUID index keys, later-table multiple indexes or generalized nullable combinations
Deep Long Seek samples exactly nine keys; full traversal remains exhaustive
No mutation, rollback, query preservation, empty LVAL or whole-v1 completeness claim
claims: Finite hosted creation comparison only. Prior local evidence EXP-0146/0166/0190/0202 motivates recipes but does not substitute for this acquisition. No automatic support movement, full #100/#102 closure or broad compatibility claim.
